environment.description: Same EKS cluster but pod runs with Cilium CNI in strict mode. A CiliumNetworkPolicy with L7 HTTP-aware egress rules is applied to the pod's namespace. The policy specifies toFQDNs matchPattern allowing only '*.customer-webhooks.example.com' on port 443, and toCIDR 10.200.0.0/16 (HSM proxy subnet) on port 9223. Additionally, the node's iptables PREROUTING chain has a DROP rule for any traffic from pod CIDR destined to 169.254.169.254 (IMDS blocked at node level via ec2-metadata-no-token instance tag combined with HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1 on the launch template). The HSM proxy itself validates that the calling pod's SPIFFE identity matches the registered workload before processing sign requests, meaning even if SSRF reaches the HSM proxy with a forged path, the mTLS SPIFFE-based auth rejects it unless the original pod identity is presented.

config.imds_protection: HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1, node-level iptables DROP for pod-CIDR->169.254.169.254
config.hsm_auth: SPIFFE mTLS workload identity verification on HSM proxy (only registered pod identity accepted)
config.service_mesh: Cilium service mesh with mutual TLS enforcement
